summary: BUUU Group Limited (NASDAQ: BUUU) filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-binding MOU to explore acquiring PINK 308 LLC, a holding company for film assets, to enter AI-driven short-form drama and IP-centric digital entertainment. Terms are undisclosed; no price, premium, or break fee stated. Completion is subject to due diligence, transfer of film libraries free of encumbrances into PINK 308, and other conditions. The board supports the strategic transition, with no advisors named. This early-stage, non-binding deal carries high uncertainty; watch for definitive agreement, financing, and regulatory timelines.
